description: Tier 4. The condensed 'over time' view. Compresses what used to be TWO full dashboard cards (net worth + framework-level progress) into ONE compact horizontal glass row, split by a center divider. Deliberately demoted below the right-now tiers per the north star.

designSystem.centerDivider: 1px vertical rule colors.borderGlass with spacing.md each side

netWorth.description: Total net worth: cash + investments + property - debt

netWorthDeltaPercent.description: Percent change vs prior snapshot; sign-colored

netWorthHistory.description: Series for the sparkline; degrades to no sparkline if < 2 points

levelLabel.truncation: levelName truncates first; numbers never truncate (flexShrink:0)

stateTreatments.error: inline 'Couldn't load — Retry' within the strip only; does not take down the screen
stateTreatments.empty: if no net-worth history and no level data, hide the strip entirely

accessibility.label: Net worth {netWorth}, {up|down} {deltaPercent} percent. Level {level}, {levelName}, {progressPercent} percent.
accessibility.hint: Double tap to view progress details
accessibility.colorIndependence: delta uses ▲/▼ glyph + word-equivalent, not color alone

developerNotes: All inputs already exist on the current dashboard (netWorth, netWorthHistory, frameworkLevel). This is pure re-layout: two cards to one row. Reuse Sparkline; do not reimplement.
